explanation: Generated the eta-channel EXCLURAD input for the requested 3x3 grid at cos(theta*)=0 and phi*=90 using the validated default settings: beam energy 6.53 GeV, vcut 0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) radiative-correction mode. The kinematics themselves are not physically rejected, but the lookup-table coverage could not be verified because the eta table was not available to scan. Also, the eta build in this directory will fail at runtime until the required lookup table is present at the hardcoded filename maid07-PPpi.tbl.
